name: _awards-footer.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  about/_awards-footer.scss — the awards footer band below Contact — dark surface skeleton tokens, compact awards carousel slot, and the legal-links row.
//  Imported by about.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Awards footer (below Contact, same dark background) ──────────────────────
.about-aw-ft {
  @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: $color-white;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-3xl);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }
  @include layout-2560() {
    padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
  }

  // The awards carousel itself — limit max width so it feels compact & centred
  .aw-c--awards {
    max-width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    width: 100%;
  }

  // Legal links row: same border + padding as .contact-social
  &-skel {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: to-rem($space-xl) 0;
  }
}

// Awards links row.
.about-awards-links {
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0;
  color: var(--white);
  width: 100%;
  padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-lg) 0;
  border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--grey);
  margin-top: to-rem($space-lg);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-4xl) 0;
  }

  &-item {
    @extend .ttl-xs;
    @extend %LK_LINK;

    color: var(--white);
    text-decoration: none;
    // The %LK_LINK underline is a border-bottom — keep the line box tight
    // so it hugs the baseline like a real underline, and carry the row
    // spacing on margins instead of an inflated line-height.
    margin-block: to-rem($space-md);
    line-height: to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  &-sep {
    padding: 0 to-rem($space-md);
    font-weight: 200;
  }
}
